testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-percent-off-product-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify percent off product promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user (the promotion's profile) checks that an automatic Percent Off Product promotion gives no discount on a product it does not cover or on two eligible products at quantity 1, then applies once both eligible lines are raised: discount = percent x subtotal, order total = subtotal - discount. No order is placed.
steps: Sign in with username/password (empty storage state) and empty the cart
Add the other product (sku1) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount; empty the cart
Add the two eligible products (sku2, sku3) at quantity 1, open the cart (2 lines), check there is no discount
Raise both eligible lines (name2, name3) to updatedQuantity, reloading after each; check the quantities and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read both unit costs (> 0), subtotal, discount, order total: discount = discountAmount% x subtotal; order total = subtotal - discount
Open the cart and check the header total, empty the cart, check the empty-cart message, log out
stateChanges: Registered user's cart: products added, quantities raised, emptied at cleanup
The promotion is only read; no order is placed
assertions: No discount with only the other product
No discount with both eligible products at quantity 1
Both line quantities equal updatedQuantity; discount label 'Discount (On Sub Total)' visible
Discount close to discountAmount% of subtotal (precision 2)
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
Cart header total visible; empty cart message visible; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify percent off product promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO 20% product promotion, signed-in user = the selected profile
Profile: sku1 z-2100012 (Schlage) and sku3 z-2510011 (EcoSmart) are simple; sku2 B-100004 is a ConfigurableProduct (the cart line is its variant, found by the name fragment '75-Watt')

Both eligible products declared as productType simple: the assertions only need two eligible lines; a simple product avoids variant selection and the unprofiled parent inventory (B-100004 inventory NOT_FOUND). sku2 therefore has no preferred source
The export's non-selected-profile check is manual; allProfiles false keeps the promotion mapped to 'Retail Customer' (default registered profile, assumed to be the declared user's)
Recorded discountAmount 20.00 and updatedQuantity 5 are role data of the promotion (discountAmount, minimumQuantity)

The discounted / not-discounted products are tied to the resolved promotion through their 'promotion' param, written as '@promotion.promoCode' (the promo code output of the promotion need in this test); the resolver cannot bind a param to another need's output yet (reported gap)

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2c): product1/product2 belowOrderMinimum @promotion.orderMinimum and minimumQuantity @promotion.minimumQuantity: no discount at the starting quantity and the minimum reachable within each product's cart limit

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): signed-in cart (Retail order minimum 650): both lines are raised to qty = max(minimumQuantity 5, floor(400 / (p1 + p2)) + 1) (PromoPercentOffProduct 9: orderMinimum 400, QuantityMinimum 5). At qty 5 the cart is 5 x (p1 + p2) < 650 -> each price < 65 -> maxPrice 65; above qty 5 the cart is at most 400 + p1 + p2 < 530

User decision 2026-10-29 (data gap): maxPrice raised to 105 on both products. With 65 only z-2200004 ($22.48) qualified, so product2 had no record; z-2420001 (about $69) now qualifies and the pair sums to about $91.50 (5 x 91.50 = $457 < 650). A pair summing over $130 would cross the Retail order minimum; the spec's subtotal soft check reports that case

User decision 2026-10-29: minMaxQuantity is linked to @promotion.minimumQuantity (PromoPercentOffProduct 9: QuantityMinimum 5), so the product's cart limit follows the promotion if its minimum changes

User decision 2026-10-31: belowOrderMinimum and minimumQuantity removed from product1/product2. Their per-product check (price x cart limit >= orderMinimum 400) rejected z-2200004 ($22.48) although the PAIR qualifies (5 x (22.48 + 69) = $457 > 400) because the spec raises both lines together. No discount at quantity 1 is already guaranteed by the promotion's QuantityMinimum 5; maxPrice 105 and minMaxQuantity stay

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): minMaxQuantity 5 on both = the promotion's minimum quantity and the reserved quantity (quantityUsed 5, spec RESERVED_QUANTITY 5); the computed quantity stays 5 only when p1 + p2 > 80, which no param enforces
